summary: Ansible 11 community.aws breaking changes: botocore<1.31.0 and boto3<1.28.0 are unsupported, ec2_launch_template tags now apply to the template itself, and autoscaling_instance_refresh(_info), ec2_launch_template and ec2_placement_group moved to amazon.aws.
questions: Which boto3 version does community.aws need in Ansible 11?
Do ec2_launch_template tags apply to instances?
